products.product_description: New Mexico Pinon Coffee. Dark Pinon Single Serve 10ct. Product Number:F03308 UPC:812361033081. Single Serve (Keurig) Cups, filled with ground coffee flavored with natural flavorings.
products.reason_for_recall: Clear coat seal on the lid of the single serve cups did not get applied consistently to all cups in the production run. This resulted in the food safe ink printing on some cups to run when exposed to high temperature, high-pressure water used in a K-cup machine.
